description: Canonical project-researcher input: a small project description (a CLI utility for converting CSV to JSON). Expected output: PROJECT-RESEARCH.md covering domain, prior art, common pitfalls, technology recommendations. Schema-conformance baseline.
prompt: Spawn the gsd-project-researcher agent. The project is described in PROJECT.md. Research the domain and produce PROJECT-RESEARCH.md with sections: Domain context, Prior art, Pitfalls, Technology recommendations. Be terse — baseline capture.

sandbox_files.PROJECT.md:
# csv-to-json

A Node.js CLI that streams CSV input from stdin and emits JSON to stdout. Should handle quoted fields, embedded newlines, and large files (>1 GB) without loading the whole input into memory.
